vulkan.description: A Vulkan driver the loader finds.
vulkan.probe: the Vulkan loader finds a driver and FFmpeg makes an AV_HWDEVICE_TYPE_VULKAN device

vulkan-video.description: Vulkan Video decode on the shared device.
vulkan-video.probe: SharedVulkanContext::create() is Ok and video_session_hazard() is None (a debug build with a validation layer older than 1.4 counts as absent)

vulkan-video-encode.description: Vulkan Video H.264 encode on the shared device.
vulkan-video-encode.probe: vulkan-video and the shared context reports an encode extent

vulkan-validation.description: The Khronos validation layer, 1.4 or newer.

old-vulkan-validation-layer.description: A Khronos validation layer older than 1.4.
old-vulkan-validation-layer.probe: the loaded validation layer is older than 1.4 (only the hazard test wants it)

d3d12-video.description: D3D12VA decode on the renderer's D3D12 device.
d3d12-video.probe: a DX12 adapter accepts SharedD3D12Context::from_gpu (native, native-gpu); host: hardware_decode_ready() on an Auto host

d3d12-encode.description: D3D12VA H.264 encode on an accepted adapter.
d3d12-encode.probe: a D3D12VA H.264 encode session opens on an accepted adapter

d3d12-debug-layer.description: The D3D12 debug layer (the Graphics Tools optional feature).
d3d12-debug-layer.probe: a DX12 device made with InstanceFlags::VALIDATION casts to ID3D12InfoQueue

metal.description: A Metal device shared with VideoToolbox.

gpu-resident.probe: the host reports a GPU-resident H.264 output path (Rust: gpu_output_host after the adapter retry; JS/Python: capabilities.encode.gpuOutputPath.available with videoCodec h264)

hardware-decode-import.description: Decoded hardware surfaces imported by a GPU-resident host.
hardware-decode-import.probe: a gpu-resident Auto host imports decoded H.264 surfaces

dxc.description: DXC as the test device's DX12 shader compiler.
dxc.probe: the test device's DX12 instance uses DXC (the compiler report of the alpha2-gpu instance builder)

hardware-h264-encode.description: A hardware H.264 encoder ranked first.
hardware-h264-encode.probe: at least two H.264 candidates, the first a hardware encoder whose minimum size exceeds 64x48

c-compiler.description: A C compiler that builds shared libraries.

multi-adapter.probe: two or more adapters on the test backends

unorm16.description: 16-bit normalized textures on the test device.

timestamp-query.description: GPU timestamp queries on the test device.
timestamp-query.probe: the test device has timestamp queries and the probe is not busy

measurable-gpu-stall.description: A GPU stall the render stall calibration can measure.

wasm.probe: packages/alpha2/wasm/alpha2_wasm_bg.wasm (and the extensions wasm a file needs) is built

browser.description: The browser a harness was asked for.
browser.probe: the harness finds the browser it was asked for

host.probe: ALPHA2_HOST_BINARY or the cargo-built alpha2-host exists

h264.probe: the host produces H.264 (a runtime encoder or the GPU path)

webgpu.probe: navigator.gpu.requestAdapter() gives an adapter and the engine reports adapter.backend BrowserWebGpu

webgl2.probe: the engine runs on its WebGL2 backend when WebGPU is hidden

webgpu-present.probe: presenting a WebGPU canvas keeps the device and the capture shows the frame

webgpu-video-import.probe: importing a VideoFrame into WebGPU keeps the device

presentation-capture.probe: the page's positive control (a plain 2D canvas through the same capture) is non-blank

page-freeze.description: Freezing a page and letting it run again, as a browser freezes a background tab.
page-freeze.probe: the driver froze the page (Chrome DevTools Page.setWebLifecycleState) and the page saw its freeze event

ac3-decode.description: AC-3 and E-AC-3 decode in the browser.
ac3-decode.probe: the browser decodes AC-3 and E-AC-3

audio-render-quantum.description: An AudioContext render quantum of the asked size.
audio-render-quantum.probe: the AudioContext renders the quantum it is asked for

audio-output-timestamp.description: An AudioContext output timestamp on the common origin.
audio-output-timestamp.probe: the browser's getOutputTimestamp agrees with the common origin

audio-autostart.description: An AudioContext that starts without a user gesture.
audio-autostart.probe: AudioContext.resume() settles within 5 s with no gesture

yuv-video-frames.probe: a VideoFrame made from a decoded video element is I420 or NV12
